description: This file defines global directory paths and initialization functions for Android's installation daemon, including setting up directory paths based on environment variables.

methods.name: init_globals_from_data_and_root
methods.description: Initializes global directory paths based on environment variables ANDROID_DATA and ANDROID_ROOT.

methods.name: init_globals_from_data_and_root (overload)
methods.description: Sets up directory paths using provided data and root paths.

methods.name: ensure_trailing_slash
methods.description: Ensures a directory path ends with a slash.
